account: Today I have mostly seen ordinary town business, with a few things I cannot yet explain. Several townsfolk told me the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery, and I later saw the baker carrying a sack of bread near the plaza. That could simply be normal baking and market deliveries; I have no evidence of another purpose. My neighbour said they had chatted with the baker, who said there was no special occasion today. I do not know whether that remark has any significance. Freight crossed east over the bridge before I could get an answer about trade. My neighbour invited me for our scheduled three o'clock tea and gave the address as the cottage at (16, -60, 105), nearest the east landing. The secretary has the appointment book, reported no correspondence, and was investigating the tea location. I heard several later calls from the secretary but could not make out their words, so there may be news I have missed. I have now returned from my noon visit home for the one o'clock town accounts appointment. The builder is outside town hall holding a lantern, with several townsfolk nearby. I do not yet know why they are here. I feel there may be business I am not hearing about, but nothing I have actually learned establishes a secret gathering or unusual plan.
